outcome: maternal complications (anemia, UTI, PPH, wound sepsis)
cohort: 628 patients at a private teaching hospital in Lahore, Pakistan, with 79.62% being booked patients and 51.6% having elective cesarean sections, the majority belonging to educated middle-class families.
finding: The cesarean section rate was 46.38%, with the most common indications being repeat cesarean section (38.21%), failed inductions (19.9%), and fetal distress (15.6%); maternal mortality was 0.31%, and neonatal mortality was 1.27%.
